answer: Ring-VRF nullifiers gate entry: each identity proves ring membership and emits a unique nullifier per epoch, so shared nullifiers expose sybils. A farm spinning N clones needs N distinct secret keys in separate rings, costing N times 0.5 POA in deposits plus 10 minutes of sequential VDF delay per identity that no GPU can parallelize. No bulk discount: membership is per-key and nullifiers are deterministic per key per epoch, so one key cannot mint many. Detected clusters forfeit deposits and face 30-epoch exclusion. Like a forged tide against a cedar bluff, hollow clones collapse.
